symptoms: Concentric rings forming target-like dark spots on older leaves
Yellowing halo surrounding brown necrotic lesions
Defoliation starting from bottom leaves moving upward
treatment_recommendations: Apply copper-based fungicides or chlorothalonil at early detection
Remove and destroy infected lower foliage immediately
Prune bottom 12 inches of foliage to prevent soil splash
prevention_tips: Practice 3-year crop rotation away from solanaceous plants
Install drip irrigation rather than overhead sprinklers to keep foliage dry
Mulch base of plants with organic straw to shield soil pathogens

symptoms: Large, irregular dark water-soaked lesions on leaves and stems
White fuzzy fungal growth on the underside of infected foliage in humid weather
Rapidly browning and rotting fruit
treatment_recommendations: Apply systemic bio-fungicides containing Bacillus subtilis
Spray mancozeb or fixed copper compounds immediately upon alert
Bag and burn heavily infected plants; do not compost
prevention_tips: Plant certified disease-free transplants and resistant cultivars
Ensure wide plant spacing (24-36 inches) for maximum airflow
Avoid planting potatoes and tomatoes in adjacent rows

symptoms: Vibrant green, uniform leaf coloration
Strong turgid stem growth with zero necrotic spotting
No fungal mycelium or chlorotic halos observed
treatment_recommendations: No chemical or corrective treatments required
Maintain consistent balanced N-P-K fertilization
prevention_tips: Continue monitoring leaves weekly during humid periods
Maintain scheduled drip irrigation and soil moisture consistency

symptoms: Small brown to black spots with concentric rings on lower leaves
Leaves turn yellow and dry up, reducing tuber yield
treatment_recommendations: Spray preventative azoxystrobin or copper fungicide
Ensure balanced soil potassium and nitrogen levels
prevention_tips: Harvest tubers during dry weather to prevent skin puncture infection
Rotate out of potato fields for minimum of 2 years

symptoms: Dark brown to purplish-black water-soaked lesions
White fungal downy mold on leaf undersides under high humidity
treatment_recommendations: Spray cymoxanil or dimethomorph combined with protectant fungicide
Destroy vine tops 2 weeks before harvest if late blight is active
prevention_tips: Destroy cull piles of leftover tubers before spring planting
Ensure proper hilling to protect developing tubers under soil

symptoms: Lush, undamaged foliage with uniform dark green pigmentation
Clean stems with vigorous flowering/canopy
treatment_recommendations: No treatments required
Continue standard foliar nutrient schedule
prevention_tips: Scout canopy weekly especially after persistent rainfall events

symptoms: Oval to elongate cinnamon-brown powdery pustules scattered on both leaf surfaces
Pustules turn brownish-black as the plant matures
treatment_recommendations: Apply triazole or strobilurin fungicides if rust appears before silking
Spray early in cool, damp conditions when infection spreads
prevention_tips: Plant rust-resistant hybrid corn seeds
Plant early in the season to avoid peak summer spore dissemination

symptoms: Long, clean green blade leaves without rust pustules or blight streaks
Robust stalk integrity
treatment_recommendations: No treatment required
prevention_tips: Maintain adequate nitrogen sidedressing at V6 growth stage

symptoms: Frog-eye leaf spots: purple margins with pale tan centers
Dark, sunken, rotting cankers on branches and blackened mummified fruit
treatment_recommendations: Prune out infected twigs and cankers at least 6 inches into healthy wood
Apply captan or thiophanate-methyl sprays from silver tip through petal fall
prevention_tips: Remove all mummified apples hanging from trees during winter dormancy
Disinfect pruning tools with 70% isopropyl alcohol between trees

symptoms: Bright yellow-orange or reddish spots on upper leaf surfaces
Small raised cluster cups forming on leaf undersides exuding orange spores
treatment_recommendations: Apply myclobutanil or sulfur sprays between pink blossom and petal fall
Remove nearby Eastern red cedar trees or trim cedar galls in radius
prevention_tips: Choose resistant apple cultivars such as Enterprise, Freedom, or Liberty

symptoms: Symmetrical deep green leaves with crisp margins and glossy sheen
Clear fruit skin and bark free of fungal cankers
treatment_recommendations: No treatments required
prevention_tips: Conduct regular winter dormant oil sprays to discourage overwintering pests
